system.description:
ARCHETYPE UNLIVING

Prerequisites Level 12

Your mortality has been severed and your soul bound into a vessel of eternal resurgence.

Through forbidden rite, cold intellect and deliberate necromancy, you have crossed the threshold into lichdom. Your body is now only the outward instrument of a soul anchored elsewhere, making ordinary destruction an inconvenience rather than an end. You gain the Shared Unliving Base Mods, Immunity to Bleed and the Phylactery of Eternal Resurgence.

Level 12, as the entry prints (Graham's ruling of 7 Oct 2026; the chapter introduction's "10th" is the slip). Grants Darkvision, the Shared Unliving Base Mods, immunity to Bleed and the Phylactery of Eternal Resurgence (the ability; the vessel is a wondrous item). One Unliving archetype per character.
system.grantedAbilities: Darkvision, Shared Unliving Base Mods, Phylactery of Eternal Resurgence
